notes: Emsisoft deploy now returns working download links, plus two improvements. (1) Install links fixed: a brand-new workspace's /install endpoint hangs, so the app now creates the install token via the workspace's policy group and reads the real download links (web, direct, macOS) from that — no more timeout. (2) Deploy now checks first whether a workspace already exists for that customer; if so it offers 'Get install links' instead of creating a duplicate. Also widened the top-right ticket bar so the customer name and number aren't cut off.
